{{Top}}
[[File:Ongree_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|210px|The mouths of [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] were located above the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].]]
{{Dialogue|Lyari|Come on, bright boy. Give us a chance.|Luke|No. That would never work.|Zelara|Why not?|Luke|Because I have lips, and you have beaks, for starters.|attr=[[Lyari]] and [[Zelara]] make a pass on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|src=<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
The '''mouth''' or '''maw''' was a part of the anatomy on most [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was used to speak, eat, and drink. It was usually located below the [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and above the chin on a being's face.
